lane: تليّث 5 and ↓لَيَّثَ and لُيِّثَ _He_ (a man, TA,) _became like the Benoo-Leyth,_ or, _like a lion, in desire;_ expl. by صَارَ لَيْثِىَّ الهَوَى; (K;) _and in zeal in the cause of his party:_ (TA:) _he became like a lion;_ as also ↓إِسْتَلْيَثَ. (L.)
